scope: Author review of all 49 added occupation bindings, 10 direct technology activity bindings and all 23 development profiles gaining a first supported Top. Holdout cases not inspected or edited. This is not an independent psychometric review.
criteria: Check the existing sourced profession questions against the frozen positive topic, method and responsibility IDs.
Preserve all official ratings, profiles, previous mappings and Top gates. Changes to ten technology activity options are direct authored bindings; no new occupation-link propagation.
Use explicit conjunctions; unstated specialist interests remain unfamiliar.
Retain broad interest correlations even when they conflict with specific learning interests. A supported specific interest is not proof of high broad correlation, ability or eventual success.
No automatic medical-specialty, game-design, religious, marine or nuclear inference from broad fields.
The fixed first-three Top display and degree-route classification are unchanged.
